project.name: KHKD - Toxoplasma Gondii
project.description: Vietnamese science-horror Reel — ky sinh trung Toxoplasma dieu khien hanh vi nguoi nuoi meo
project.story: Toxoplasma gondii is a parasitic protozoan that completes its life cycle only inside cats. It infects rats and mice by hijacking their brain — instead of fearing cat urine, infected rats become attracted to it, walking right into the cat's territory to be eaten. The parasite then breeds inside the cat. Roughly one third of all humans on Earth carry latent Toxoplasma, and emerging research suggests it may affect human risk-taking behavior and personality.
